summary: Wahab answered 'Yes' when directly asked about Gaza genocide at an April 2026 forum, introduced a California Senate resolution calling the conflict a genocide and demanding its end, and cosponsored the Block the Bombs Act. She voted against a bill to defund universities boycotting Israel, is owner-confirmed in the pro-Palestine Muslim community, and holds a CAIR Action endorsement and Vote for Peace Ally rating while UDP spent $1.6 million against her. She has not separately sponsored genocide-recognition or UNRWA-restoration bills.
